func (l *Ledger) Transfer(ctx, id, from, to string, amount int64) (Receipt, error) {
  if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil { return Receipt{}, err }
  l.mu.Lock(); defer l.mu.Unlock()
  if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil { return Receipt{}, err } // re-check under lock
  if id == "" || from == "" || to == "" { return Receipt{}, ErrInvalid } — actually nonempty ID required; accounts distinct and existing. from==to → ErrInvalid.
  if from == to → ErrInvalid
  if _, ok := l.balances[from]; !ok → ErrMissingAccount
  if _, ok := l.balances[to]; !ok → ErrMissingAccount
  if amount <= 0 → ErrInvalid
  if existing, ok := l.receipts[id]; ok {
    if existing.From==from && existing.To==to && existing.Amount==amount { return existing, nil }
    return Receipt{}, ErrConflict
  }
  if l.balances[from] < amount → ErrInsufficientFunds
  l.balances[from]-=amount; l.balances[to]+=amount
  r := Receipt{...}
  l.receipts[id]=r
  return r, nil
}
